names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9960, «Георгий (Седов), исп.», with the rank and grade words left off. The day line declines the forename and prints no surname. No other folder in this corpus holds this surname.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 декабря ст. ст. — «Св. Георгия исп (1960)»
